title: Open AI Setup and the expert connection form

provenance.kind: Genuine screen recording of operator actions in real software
provenance.operator: Demo operator using agent-operated UI tools

source.storage: Private recording retained outside the repository

edit.method: Three source ranges joined in their original order, with idle gaps removed; normal speed, full frame, no overlays, no generated UI, and no added cursor.
edit.rangeConvention: Start inclusive, end exclusive; seconds from source start

actions.label: I'm an expert
actions.result: The Connect your AI form opens with empty connection and API-key fields.

actionTimingBasis: Click times supplied by the capture operator; source and output states visually confirmed. Visual-transition times come from ffmpeg scene-change detection and are not click-event timestamps.

privacyReview.method: 43 one-second samples across the output, eight full-resolution source frames, and a decoded all-frame scene-change scan (860 frames, threshold 0.04).
observations: No terminal, password value, API-key value, or private filesystem path observed.
The API-key field is empty in reviewed connection-form frames.
The visible Workshop AI connection name, model ID google/gemini-3-flash-preview, OpenRouter base URL, and localhost application route are demo/public configuration metadata.
No cursor is embedded in reviewed frames; no cursor was added during editing.
privacyReview.limitations: This is a visual sampling review with an all-frame scene-change scan, not OCR or a frame-by-frame credential audit. The full 900-second source remains private and is not approved for public use.
privacyReview.publicScope: Only the 43-second output asset and this sanitized manifest are approved for public use.
